en: A Soviet-era postcard featuring a large portrait illustration of Vladimir Lenin on the left. On the right there is an attached commemorative postage stamp and a red cancellation mark. The design includes red flags, a building and the Roman numerals 'XXVI' referring to the 26th Congress of the Communist Party. Russian (Cyrillic) text appears in blue and red, and the year 1981 is printed on the stamp.
